messages.subject: Google sheets in Shinyserver
parts:
I have used google sheets for my app. and while I run it locally, it works fine as i have .httr-auth file. But when I move the data to Shiny-server folder, I could not find the httr-auth file. and as a result the tab panel where the google sheet display throws an error like "contact app author" 

I am using gs_title for getting sheets. I also used gs_url and tried, But didn't work.

messages.author: 6c4d187713e325b8
messages.subject: Re: Google sheets in Shinyserver
parts:
Hi Ashok,
        It could be a login issue, what code are you using to log into your google account through googlesheets? It's a good idea to use the physical ttt.rds file to login when using shiny, to stop googlesheets from asking the app for the password each time your app initiates. If you do this, make sure you have the file in the working directory folder, and select this file to upload to the server when you publish. The walkthrough for the googlesheets package has a section on setting up the ttt.rds file, and using this to login. 

Good luck,
      Conal
